cohort: The cohort consisted of 134 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery, divided into seropositive and seronegative groups for viral hepatitis.
finding: No significant difference was found in peri-operative haemoglobin level, blood product and intravenous iron supplementation, intra-operative adhesions, or difficulty in hemostasis between sero-positive and sero-negative viral hepatitis pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during the elective cesarean delivery period between October 2018 and March 2019.
